name: Save Card - UtiityTask
purpose: Deprecated Activity utility (Task card). Save action of the Task card: builds a JSON from UtilityTask (creator = session user party, date, ids, assigned by/to, regarding, subject), commits, calls karbon_kontroller Create Task when no activity is selected or Edit Task (deprecated) otherwise, shows an error dialog on failure, then either clears Subject for another task or closes the card.

UtilityTask::DueDate#9 (step 3)
UtilityTask::Id#10 (step 3)
UtilityTask::EntityId#23 (step 3)
UtilityTask::PartyAssignedById#6 (step 3)
UtilityTask::PartyRegardingId#12 (step 3)
UtilityTask::PartyAssignedToId#7 (step 3)
UtilityTask::Subject#8 (step 3)
Selected_Activity::Id#1 (step 9)
calls:
karbon_kontroller.fmp12/scripts/391 "Create Task { data }" (step 11, in=karbon_kontroller.fmp12)
karbon_kontroller.fmp12/scripts/544 "Edit Task { data } _deprecated" (step 13, in=karbon_kontroller.fmp12)
open_question: CreateAnother is read from the JSON built here, which never contains that key, so it is always empty and the card always closes. The task itself is written by kontroller scripts 391 and 544.
